ValidationRule.description: #21200- making the Validation rule applicable for all profiles #22087- Added bypass logic #24480-Making Applicable for all Record type
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED( StageName ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName),'5 - Signed/PO in'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName),'6 - Setup'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName),'7 - Closed') ),
NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, '6 - Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Lost'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '7 - Closed'), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'5 - Signed/PO in') ) ),
$Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin', $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator',
NOT($Permission.Update_Stage_of_Closed_Opportunities), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: An Opportunity that's already won cannot be re-opened. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
